probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites; (b) receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (c) sending a request based on said search query to a computerised system of a contact center __only when the search query indicates a need for contact center assistance__; (d) receiving, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, wherein said contact center link, when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __that is selected based on analysis of the search query content and user context__; and (e) returning said contact center link to said user as part of a response to said search query __wherein the contact center link is dynamically generated and includes embedded session parameters__.

2. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, further comprising the steps of conducting a search within said documents on one or more websites in response to said search query __using a specialized search algorithm that differentiates between document-based results and contact center resources__, and returning at least one document link to one of said documents as part of said response to said search query.

3. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 2, further comprising the step of formatting said response to said search query to display a first result set including said document link and a second result set including said contact center link __wherein the second result set is prioritized based on relevance scoring of the search query to contact center capabilities__.

4. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) enable a plurality of contact center links to be provided to said user __each corresponding to different contact center resources or departments selected based on the search query analysis__.

5. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise said contact center link __which includes encoded information about the originating search query and user session context__.

6. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise an identifier of a link cached by the search engine __and further include metadata about the cache entry creation time and relevance score__.

7. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link is generated uniquely for said user __based on a combination of user identifier, search query content, and timestamp__, whereby activation of the link initiates an interactive communications session recognisable by the contact center as relating to said request from said search engine __and enables the contact center to retrieve the original search context__.

8. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said request sent to said contact center includes an identifier of said user __and metadata about the search query including keywords and search context__, whereby a subsequent interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center arising from initiation of said contact center link enables the contact center to associate said interactive communications session with said request from the search engine.

9. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 8, wherein said identifier of said user is a network address of said user __or a unique session identifier assigned by the search engine__.

10. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined agent of the contact center __having specific skills or expertise matching the search query requirements__ selected in response to said request.

11. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined queue of agents of the contact center __organized by skill set or department__ selected in response to said request.

12. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said link is configured to initiate a communications session from a compatible communications application __installed on the user's computer system__, if such application is available on said user's computer.

13. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is a voice or video telephony application __that supports session parameter passing__.

14. (Original) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is an instant messaging (IM) application.

15. (Original) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is integrated with a browser employed by the user to access the search engine interface.

16. (New) [Claim 16 is withdrawn to correct misnumbering.]

17. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link contains parameters representing customer requirements __derived from analysis of the search query__ which are passed to said contact center within an interactive communications session initiated on activation of said contact center link.

18. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said parameters are indicative of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center __and are determined by matching search query keywords to predefined skillset categories__, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters.

19. (Currently amended) A computer program product comprising a program carrier encoding instructions which, when executed by a search engine computer system, are effective to cause said search engine computer system to: (a) provide a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites; (b) receive a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (c) send a request based on said search query to a computerised system of a contact center __only when the search query indicates a need for contact center assistance__; (d) receive, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, wherein said contact center link, when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __that is selected based on analysis of the search query content and user context__; and (e) return said contact center link to said user as part of a response to said search query __wherein the contact center link is dynamically generated and includes embedded session parameters__.

20. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented search engine system providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising: (a) a server for providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites and receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (b) an interface for providing communication with a computerised system of a contact center; (c) a request generator for formulating a request based on said search query for sending to said computerised system of a contact center __that includes analysis of whether the search query indicates a need for contact center assistance__; (d) a results generator for providing to said user a contact center link based on data received in response to said request, said contact center link being configured such that, when activated, it enables an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __selected based on the search query analysis and user context__.

21. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein the request includes search query keywords and user session information__; (b) determining, from said request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that map search query characteristics to contact center resources__; (c) sending to the search engine, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, whereby said contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and said selected resource of the contact center __and includes encoded information enabling session context retrieval__; (d) receiving, from said user, a communications session initiation from which said selected resource may be identified __and which includes the encoded session information__; and (e) directing said communications session to said selected resource.

22. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprise an address of said selected resource __and session parameters derived from the original search query__, whereby activation of the link enables the user to initiate a communications session directly with said resource.

23. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises an identification, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center __determined by matching search query keywords to predefined skillset categories__, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters.

24. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises a unique identifier, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, said unique identifier being assigned to said request received from said search engine __and incorporating search query content and user session information__, whereby a later communications session may be associated with said request based on said unique identifier being communicated within said communications session.

25. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, further comprising the step, carried out after having received a communications session initiation from the user, of amending the stored rules __based on the outcome of the communications session and whether the selected resource was appropriate for the user's needs__.

26. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine __and the search query keywords contained therein__ and the resource identified in a contact center link activated by the user.

27. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine __and the search query keywords contained therein__ and a resource of the contact center which is different from that specified in a contact center link activated by the user but to which the user's communications session is ultimately directed.

28. (Currently amended) A computer program product comprising a program carrier encoding instructions which, when executed by a computer system of a contact center, are effective to cause the computer system to: (a) receive from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein the request includes search query keywords and user session information__; (b) determine, from the request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that map search query characteristics to contact center resources__; (c) send to the search engine, in response to the request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to the user, whereby the contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and the selected resource of the contact center __and includes encoded information enabling session context retrieval__; (d) receive, from the user, a communications session initiation from which the selected resource may be identified __and which includes the encoded session information__; and (e) direct the communications session to the selected resource.

29. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented contact center system for providing users with access to a resource of a contact center system, comprising (a) an interface for receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein the request includes search query keywords and user session information__ and for returning data to the search engine in response to the request; (b) a storage area storing rules for determining, from the request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that map search query characteristics to contact center resources__; and (c) processing means programmed to determine the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on the stored rules and to generate data enabling a contact center link to be provided to the user, whereby the contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and the selected resource of the contact center __and includes encoded information enabling session context retrieval__; wherein the processor is operably connected to the interface to receive the request therefrom and to provide the data thereto.
